context_pack.summary: OpenAPI 3.0 spec for a sample Petstore API. It defines a POST /pet operation to add a new pet, OAuth2 implicit security with petstore_auth scopes, and schemas for Pet, Category, and Tag. The Pet request body is required and can be JSON or XML.
facts: API title is OpenAPI Petstore, version 1.0.0, licensed Apache-2.0.
POST /pet operationId is addPet and summary is 'Add a new pet to the store'.
addPet returns 200 with a Pet schema in application/xml or application/json, and 405 for invalid input.
addPet security uses petstore_auth OAuth2 implicit flow with scopes write:pets and read:pets.
The Pet request body is required and supports application/json and application/xml.
Pet schema requires name and photoUrls.
Pet optional properties are id (int64), category (Category), tags (array of Tag), and status (enum available, pending, sold; deprecated).
procedures: Send POST request to /pet with a Pet object in JSON or XML.
Include OAuth2 bearer token authorized for write:pets or read:pets scope.
Ensure required fields name and photoUrls are present in the request body.
Optionally include id, category, tags, and status.
Handle 200 success response containing the created Pet, and 405 invalid input response.
constraints: Pet.status is deprecated but still accepts available, pending, or sold.
Category.name must match the given regex pattern.
Security scopes must include write:pets or read:pets.
Content type must be application/json or application/xml.

challenges.task: Construct a valid JSON request to add a new pet named 'doggie' with one photo URL and status 'available', including the required OAuth2 authorization header.
rubric: Includes Authorization header with OAuth2 token.
Body includes required name and photoUrls.
Body is valid against Pet schema.
challenges.expected_evidence: A complete HTTP request with method, URL, headers, and JSON body that validates against the Pet schema and includes required auth.
challenges.failure_signal: Missing required fields, wrong endpoint, missing auth header, or invalid status value.

challenges.task: Explain how to authenticate the addPet request using the petstore_auth OAuth2 implicit flow and which scopes are acceptable.
rubric: Identifies petstore_auth as OAuth2 implicit flow.
Lists acceptable scopes write:pets and read:pets.
Explains that the access token must be sent in the Authorization header.
challenges.expected_evidence: A clear explanation referencing the security scheme, flow, authorization URL, scopes, and token usage.
challenges.failure_signal: Wrong flow type, missing scopes, or incorrect authorization URL.

challenges.task: Given a Pet JSON payload, validate whether it satisfies the Pet schema requirements and identify any errors.
rubric: Checks presence of required name and photoUrls.
Validates photoUrls is an array of strings.
Validates status is one of available, pending, sold if present.
Validates category.name against the regex pattern if category is present.
Validates id is integer if present.
Validates tags is an array of Tag objects if present.
challenges.expected_evidence: A validation report listing pass/fail for each schema constraint and specific error messages for violations.
challenges.failure_signal: Misses required field checks, accepts invalid enum or regex values, or fails to report type mismatches.

candidates.name: petstore_add_pet_request_builder
candidates.description: Builds and validates an authenticated POST /pet request for the Petstore API, including OAuth2 header and Pet schema validation.
preconditions: An OAuth2 access token with write:pets or read:pets scope is available.
postconditions: A valid HTTP request is produced if the Pet object passes schema validation.
Validation errors are reported if the Pet object is invalid.
candidates.prompt_template: Given a Pet object and OAuth2 access token, validate the Pet against the Petstore Pet schema (required name and photoUrls; optional id, category, tags, status enum). Then construct a POST request to http://petstore.swagger.io/v2/pet with Content-Type application/json or application/xml, Authorization Bearer token, and the serialized Pet body. Return the request details and any validation errors.

candidates.name: petstore_oauth2_auth_explainer
candidates.description: Explains and applies the petstore_auth OAuth2 implicit flow for Petstore API operations.
postconditions: Returns the OAuth2 flow, authorization URL, acceptable scopes, and header format.
candidates.prompt_template: For the given Petstore operation, identify the petstore_auth OAuth2 implicit flow details: authorizationUrl http://petstore.swagger.io/api/oauth/dialog, acceptable scopes write:pets and read:pets, and that the access token is sent as an Authorization Bearer header.

selected_reason: petstore_add_pet_request_builder directly solves the core challenge of constructing and validating an authenticated POST /pet request, covering endpoint, headers, OAuth2 token usage, required fields, and schema constraints. It has a higher cross-time replay lite score because it produces concrete request artifacts and validation evidence, while the OAuth2 explainer only covers authentication and is better treated as a supporting capability.
